name: moderate-llama
description: Screen text with llama-guard-4-12b, Meta's dedicated 12B safety classifier (164K-token context), which returns a safe/unsafe verdict plus the policy categories a violation falls under. Use for long passages, whole chat transcripts, or a model's own reply, and for brand-safety and policy-enforcement checks. Use moderate for short passages and OpenAI's 13-category envelope, and this when the text is longer than moderate can take.
